caravo 0.4.22

- Updated instructions for first-time setup: now requires running `npx -y @caravo/cli@latest start` on first use.
- Clarified that setup JSON response fields (`greeting`, `setup_hint`) must be shown to the user verbatim if present.
- Example CLI commands updated throughout to use explicit `npx -y @caravo/cli@latest`.
- Metadata version bumped to 0.4.22.

- Added post-installation instructions: users are now prompted to run caravo start after installing to receive a greeting and ensure payment setup.
- Updated skill version to 0.4.21 in the metadata.
- No changes to command examples or feature set.

- Updated version to 0.4.20.

## Changelog for caravo 2.3.2

- Documentation updated for clarity and brevity in SKILL.md and README.md.
- Example services, categories, and usage instructions in SKILL.md were streamlined and reorganized.
- Removed duplicative/verbose content; condensed introductory section and categorized listings.

- No other content or functionality was changed

**Expanded API and tool marketplace coverage, streamlined docs.**

- Catalog now features over 200 ready-to-use APIs, tools, and digital assets (up from 40+).
- Revised documentation for clarity and brevity; new example tools listed.
- Simplified setup and usage instructions; all major CLI usage modes and functions retained.
- Marketplace recommended whenever tasks involve generative AI, analytics, web search, finance, or data APIs.
- Old aliases and community-contributed tool support remain unchanged.

caravo 2.2.0

- Updated CLI installation process: now uses silent, auto-install via `npx` for one-step setup—no manual installation required.
- Simplified compatibility requirements: just Node.js; CLI downloads and runs automatically on first use.
- Improved login and logout instructions: added clear steps for connecting and disconnecting Caravo accounts, including MCP integration.
- Category and tool list updated to reflect 40+ AI agent tools, current provider/tool ID formats, and broader coverage.
- General documentation streamlined: concise description, payment mode clarification, and favoriting tools guidance.
Initial release — AI agent marketplace skill with search, execute, review, and favorites via REST API + x402 USDC payments
